user.title: Pawbby Smart Litter Box
user.description: Enter the Tuya credentials of your litter box (device id + local key, as extracted by the Pawbby-Reborn setup wizard). The connection is tested live.

data.ip: IP address (optional, discovered via broadcast otherwise)

cats.title: Cats
cats.description: Add up to 4 cats with their profile weight. Visits are attributed to the cat whose weight is closest (within 300 g). Leave a name empty to skip a slot.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The litter box {device_id} rejected the stored local key. Enter the new local key.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the litter box. Check device id, local key and IP.

abort.already_configured: This litter box is already configured.

action.name: Send action
action.description: Send a motor command to the litter box.

set_setting.name: Change device setting
set_setting.description: Change a hardware setting stored on the box (DP 105).
